issues.description: The getter for the ingredient name is named differently between the template and the solution: the template provides getIngredientName(), while the solution provides getName(). This identifier mismatch also appears in their respective Stock.findStockIngredient() implementations (which call getIngredientName() vs getName()). Since the problem explicitly asks students to "add getters for all the private fields", this inconsistent naming across artifacts can confuse students about which getter name to implement and which one other classes expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter name consistent across all artifacts. Either rename the template's getIngredientName() to getName() (and update any references), or change the solution's getName() to getIngredientName() and update Stock.findStockIngredient() accordingly. Also update the problem statement examples (if any) to use the chosen consistent getter name so students know which one to implement.
